top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Blackstone Data-Center Operator QTS Seeks $800 Million in Private Placement Debt
top_signals.summary: QTS, a data-center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is looking to raise around $800 million through a private placement of debt, as Wall Street looks to every corner of global credit to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: The Securities Lending Committee is a forum for market participants and authorities to discuss the UK securities lending market.

top_signals.title: Nucor Profit Beats Estimates as Higher Steel Prices Lift Results
top_signals.summary: Nucor Corp. reported third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street expectations as higher steel prices helped boost profits at the largest US steelmaker.
